# High-Recall Routing for Chapter 5B — Economic Wellbeing

## Routing Parameters
- **Source**: MAC-010 (IMF 2022 Article IV Consultation — Mexico)
- **Chapter**: 5B
- **Lenses**: 1–10 (all)
- **Mode**: High-recall; include all chunks with any marginal relevance; exclude only where content is unambiguously orthogonal to all 10 lenses.

---

## Decision Registry

| chunk_id | locator | Decision | Applicable 5B Lenses | Adjacent Context | Exclusion Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **U0001** | page 1 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.3 | Staff Report cover page establishing macroeconomic context: fiscal deficit at 3.8% GDP, public debt ~56%, inflation 8.7%, policy rate 9.25%. Directly frames fiscal/monetary conditions under which 5B.1 (prosperity agenda vs. rents/loyalty) and 5B.3 (credible fiscal/monetary rules) must be evaluated. | — | — |
